files.label: Game app
files.summary: The Mac app MacNativeGames built for Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity.
files.detail: Play opens this app. You choose its name and folder when you build it; the MacNativeGames guide names it Hyrule Warriors Age of Calamity.app. It keeps its saves, settings and logs in ~/Library/Application Support/Hyrule Warriors Age of Calamity.
